verdict.rationale: Gusto documents a native 401(k) integration via Guideline, letting partners generate access links for employer admins to set up the plan (gusto-docs-36, gusto-docs-39, gusto-docs-42, gusto-docs-54), but the evidence never explicitly states that contributions automatically sync into each payroll run once the plan is active. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic per-payroll contribution syncing/deduction logic, and any hands-on/community confirmation that 401(k) deductions flow through payroll without manual reconciliation.
